AccountSnapshot.description: The account view at a log position, recorded for audit (BP6 section 4.8).
AccountSnapshot.title: AccountSnapshot

AccountStatement.description: Balances and positions of the account as the venue reports them at ``as_of_ns``.
AccountStatement.title: AccountStatement

AccountView.description:
The account at ``as_of_ns`` as of ``log_position`` (BP6 section 4.8).

``equity_base`` is the equity in :data:`BASE_CURRENCY`, or ``None`` when a
conversion is unavailable; ``unconverted`` then lists the currencies
without a rate. ``unmargined`` lists instruments with a position and no
margin entry: margin is incomplete while it is not empty (amendment 1).
AccountView.title: AccountView

Aggressor.description: Side that initiated a trade, when the venue reports it.
Aggressor.title: Aggressor

AvailabilityBasis.description: How the availability time of the run's records was established (BP4 section 4.6).
AvailabilityBasis.title: AvailabilityBasis

Balance.description: Cash and receivable of one currency (BP6 section 4.2).
Balance.title: Balance

Bar.description:
Aggregated bar over ``[start_ns, start_ns + interval_ns)``.

``ts_event_ns`` is the end of the interval, when the bar became complete.
``revision`` and ``ts_published_ns`` follow the module rules.
Bar.title: Bar

CashTransfer.description: Deposit (positive ``amount``) or withdrawal (negative) of one currency.
CashTransfer.title: CashTransfer

ChecksumResult.description: Outcome of the provider checksum check.
ChecksumResult.title: ChecksumResult

Conversion.description:
One conversion into the base currency (BP6 section 4.4).

``unit`` is the rate's published quote convention (for example
``"EUR per USD"``), which decides whether the amount is divided or
multiplied; ``value`` is rounded once to the base currency's minor units.
Conversion.title: Conversion

CorporateActionV2.description:
Corporate action with the three dates of a cash dividend (BP6 C1).

As version 1, plus ``ex_date_ns``, ``record_date_ns`` and ``pay_date_ns``:
each the start of that date in the listing venue's time zone, as UTC
nanoseconds, set by the producer. They are required for a cash dividend and
forbidden for the other kinds. Entitlement is fixed at the ex-date (a
purchase on or after it does not receive the dividend), so for a cash
dividend ``effective_ns`` equals ``ex_date_ns``; for the other kinds
``effective_ns`` keeps its version-1 meaning. The dates are not ordered
here: for a distribution of 25 percent or more the ex-date follows the
payable date (FINRA Rule 11140(b)(2)).
CorporateActionV2.title: CorporateActionV2

CouponPayment.description: Bond coupon paid per unit of face value held (CDM: ``transfer``; intent ``CashFlow``).
CouponPayment.title: CouponPayment

CryptoSpot.description: Crypto spot pair: price of one ``base_currency`` unit in ``quote_currency``.
CryptoSpot.title: CryptoSpot

DataGap.description:
An expected interval ``[start_ns, end_ns)`` of ``key`` without a record.

``key`` is the canonical text of the instrument or series id;
``interval_ns`` is the bar interval, or ``None`` for business-day series.
``ts_event_ns`` equals ``start_ns``.
DataGap.title: DataGap

DayCount.description: Day-count convention names; the arithmetic belongs to BP6.
DayCount.title: DayCount

Difference.description: One field whose value differs; ``None`` means absent on that side.
Difference.title: Difference

ExerciseStyle.description: When an option may be exercised.
ExerciseStyle.title: ExerciseStyle

Fill.description: Execution of an order (``causation_id`` is the order id).
Fill.title: Fill

FundingPaymentV2.description:
Perpetual-swap funding for the period ``interval_ns`` ending at ``ts_event_ns`` (BP6 D3).

Positive ``funding_rate``: longs pay shorts. ``amount``, when present, is
the payment the venue reports, signed (positive = received) and in the
instrument's settlement currency; it is posted as reported (BP6 E2).
FundingPaymentV2.title: FundingPaymentV2

FuturesExpiry.description: Final settlement of a future (CDM: ``transfer``, cash or deliverable).
FuturesExpiry.title: FuturesExpiry

FxPair.description:
Currency pair: price of one ``base_currency`` unit in ``quote_currency``.

Spot carries ``settlement_lag_days``; a forward carries ``value_date_ns``.
FxPair.title: FxPair

FxSettlement.description: Exchange of the two currency amounts on the value date (CDM: ``transfer``).
FxSettlement.title: FxSettlement

GapReason.description: Why an expected interval has no record.
GapReason.title: GapReason

Identifiers.description: Optional external identifiers, each recorded only when a source supplies it.
Identifiers.title: Identifiers

IngestRun.description:
Lineage record of one ingestion run, appended after the run's records.

The run key is (``profile``, ``raw_sha256``, ``parser_id``). Counts:
``appended`` new records, ``duplicates`` records already stored with the
same content, ``revisions`` records stored as a new revision, ``gaps``
:class:`DataGap` events, ``unavailable`` records without a known
availability time. ``jurisdiction`` is the operator's declared country of
residence and access under which the source was cleared (ADR 0029).
IngestRun.title: IngestRun

InputRef.description:
One input source of a run and its terms (ADRs 0027-0029).

``runs_sha256`` hashes the sorted raw SHA-256s of the source's completed
ingestion runs in the snapshot; ``bars`` counts the bars used.
InputRef.title: InputRef

InstrumentDefined.description:
One version of an instrument specification.

``instrument.valid_from_ns`` is when the version takes effect and
``instrument.knowledge_ns`` when it became available (historical
availability, Strategy section 5). A later correction is a new event with a
later ``knowledge_ns``; a version is never edited.
InstrumentDefined.title: InstrumentDefined

InstrumentId.description:
Stable internal instrument identifier: a venue and the venue's symbol.

A symbol change creates a new identifier linked by a lifecycle event; an
identifier is never renamed in place.
InstrumentId.title: InstrumentId

LogPosition.description: The log position a view reflects: the next sequence and the hash of the last record.
LogPosition.title: LogPosition

MarginView.description:
Margin of one currency (BP6 section 4.6).

The requirement is (``initial``, ``maintenance``); the margin in use is
``initial``; ``available`` = ``equity`` - ``initial`` and ``deficit`` =
max(0, ``maintenance`` - ``equity``). All are exact and never rounded.
MarginView.title: MarginView

OptionAssignment.description: Assignment to the writer: the counterparty side of an exercise (CDM: ``exercise``).
OptionAssignment.title: OptionAssignment

OptionExercise.description: Exercise of option contracts by the holder (CDM: ``exercise``; intent ``OptionExercise``).
OptionExercise.title: OptionExercise

OptionExpiry.description: Expiry of option contracts; ``underlying_price`` decides moneyness (CDM: ``exercise``).
OptionExpiry.title: OptionExpiry

OrderSubmitted.description: An order sent towards the venue; the event id is the order id.
OrderSubmitted.title: OrderSubmitted

OrderType.description: Order types of the skeleton (market only).
OrderType.title: OrderType

Period.description: A half-open UTC interval ``[start_ns, end_ns)`` with its role.
Period.title: Period

PeriodName.description: Role of a period in the experiment (BP5 section 4.1).
PeriodName.title: PeriodName

PerpetualSwap.description: Crypto perpetual swap; ``contract_type`` selects linear or inverse arithmetic (BP6).
PerpetualSwap.title: PerpetualSwap

PositionView.description:
One instrument's position (BP6 section 4.8, C7).

``quantity`` is the filled position and ``working`` the accepted, unfilled
orders, both signed and kept apart: decisions and the pre-trade check use
``quantity + working`` (BP5 section 12, L7). ``mark`` is the latest
available mark and ``unrealized`` the profit or loss of ``quantity`` at
it, in ``currency``; an unmarked position has neither.
PositionView.title: PositionView

ReconciliationResult.description:
Result of reconciling one statement (BP6 section 4.7).

``resolves`` names the id of an earlier ``break`` result that this
``matched`` result closes.
ReconciliationResult.title: ReconciliationResult

ReconciliationStatus.description: Outcome of comparing a statement with the account.
ReconciliationStatus.title: ReconciliationStatus

ReferenceRate.description:
One published observation of a reference series (BP4 section 4.4).

``ts_event_ns`` is the observation time stated by the publisher (e.g. noon
in New York for the H.10 rates); ``ts_published_ns`` is when the value
became available (required: every reference source states or implies a
publication time). ``unit`` states the quote convention as published, e.g.
``USD per EUR`` or ``percent``; the value keeps the published digits.
ReferenceRate.title: ReferenceRate

RiskDecision.description: Pre-trade risk outcome for one order (``causation_id`` is the order id).
RiskDecision.title: RiskDecision

RunStartedV2.description:
Experiment record: the identity of one research or backtest run.

The event ``id`` is the run id. ``knowledge_ns`` is the snapshot's
knowledge time (the latest ingestion time in the input log).
RunStartedV2.title: RunStartedV2

SeriesId.description:
Identifier of a published reference series (BP4 section 4): a publisher and its code.

Reference rates (central-bank exchange rates, par yields) are observations
of a series, not tradable instruments. Publisher codes follow
:data:`VENUE_PATTERN` and series codes :data:`SYMBOL_PATTERN`, e.g.
``FRB:H10/RXI$US_N.B.EU``.
SeriesId.title: SeriesId

Settlement.description: Settlement of a derivative at expiry or exercise.
Settlement.title: Settlement

SettlementPrice.description:
Official daily settlement price of a future for one trading date (BP6 section 4.1).

``ts_published_ns`` is when the exchange published it: its availability
for point-in-time use (ADR 0028).
SettlementPrice.title: SettlementPrice

Signal.description: Direction proposed by a signal provider for one instrument (-1, 0 or +1).
Signal.title: Signal

StatementBalance.description: One currency's balance as the venue reports it.
StatementBalance.title: StatementBalance

StatementPosition.description: One instrument's signed position as the venue reports it.
StatementPosition.title: StatementPosition

Target.description: Target position (signed quantity) for one instrument.
Target.title: Target

Trial.description:
One configuration evaluated on one period of one hypothesis.

``config_hash`` identifies the configuration (signal parameters and cost
model); ``returns_sha256`` the per-period return series as text; ``sharpe``
is the per-period (not annualised) Sharpe ratio.
Trial.title: Trial

UseClass.description:
Use the operator declares for data from a source (decision log a25, a28).

``unrestricted`` is for data whose terms impose no use restriction (for
example works of the US Government, 17 U.S.C. 105).
UseClass.title: UseClass
